an10.44:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kusinārāyaṃ viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe
an10.44:2.1: codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabbo
an10.44:2.3: codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
an10.44:2.4: parisuddhakāyasamācāro nu khomhi parisuddhenamhi kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena
an10.44:2.5: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti
an10.44:2.6: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena tassa bhavanti vattāro
an10.44:2.7: iṃgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassūti itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
an10.44:3.2: parisuddhavacīsamācāro nu khomhi parisuddhenamhi vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena
an10.44:3.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti
an10.44:3.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhu parisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhena vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena tassa bhavanti vattāro
an10.44:3.5: iṃgha tāva āyasmā vācasikaṃ sikkhassūti itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
an10.44:4.2: mettaṃ nu kho cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ
an10.44:4.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti
an10.44:4.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno mettacittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ tassa bhavanti vattāro
an10.44:4.5: iṃgha āyasmā sabrahmacārīsu mettacittaṃ upaṭṭhapehīti itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
an10.44:5.2: bahussuto nu khomhi sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa me dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an10.44:5.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti
an10.44:5.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā tassa bhavanti vattāro
an10.44:5.5: iṃgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassūti itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
an10.44:6.2: ubhayāni kho me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattāni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso
an10.44:6.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu noti
an10.44:6.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno ubhayāni pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattāni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso idampanāyasmā kattha vuttaṃ bhagavatāti iti puṭṭho na sampāyati
an10.44:6.6: iṃgha tāva āyasmā vinayaṃ sikkhassūti itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:7.8: codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabboti.
